note: Residue of the platforms research document (its runtime platform test): GraphicsDeviceManager's platformSupportsOrientations is a run-time comparison of the platform name with iOS/Android, and it decides whether the preferred back-buffer size is used verbatim (desktop) or reshaped by DisplayOrientation with SupportedOrientations forwarded to the window (phones). The site listed SetSupportedOrientations but not this rule. Verified by reading modules/runtime/src/GraphicsDeviceManager.cpp (platformSupportsOrientations, INTERNAL_CreateGraphicsDeviceInformation, ApplyChanges), Sdl3SystemServices.cpp (GetPlatformName) and PresentationParameters.cpp at 009d40f5.
